headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Rose to 28.42 into the Oct. 15 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew rose to 28.42 from 16.68 into the Oct. 15 expiry, with the 75k put bid against the 91k call. The options pipe is the price of downside protection versus upside calls, and the gap widened, so more premium is bid for a drop. Bitcoin changed hands near 81k, down 3.29 percent, so the richer hedge arrived with the price lower.
author: jordan
